title: French left renews push to raise inheritance taxes, from forced philanthropy to wealth transfer cap

title: Jordan Bardella backs embattled far-right British ally Nigel Farage

title: Saudi plan for theme parks near Paris divides local residents: 'We are the forgotten ones'
subhead: Three sites, including one dedicated to the world of manga, may open in Val-d'Oise, just outside Paris. With €6 billion in investment and 22,000 jobs promised, the project has generated as much economic hope as it has concerns about the environment, housing and transportation.

title: Germany's Soviet past looms over high-stakes election in Saxony-Anhalt: 'I do not consider Russians to be enemies'
subhead: Ahead of elections on Sunday, in which the far-right Alternative for Germany could win in this region of the former East Germany, the city of Stendal – where 10,000 Red Army soldiers were stationed during the Cold War – exemplifies the unique relationship between the former German Democratic Republic and Russia.
